title: Doubleword named counters: DEFINE / GET / QUERY / DELETE DCOUNTER with an 8-byte unsigned VALUE logged as hex, GET returns the value before the increment, QUERY does not advance, values past 2**31 and 2**32 kept exactly, a deleted counter is INVREQ RESP2 201

scenarios.summary: GET / DELETE of a DCOUNTER that is not there (INVREQ 201), DEFINE VALUE(5), GET, GET, QUERY, GET, QUERY, DELETE, then GET and QUERY of the deleted counter (INVREQ 201)
DEFINE at 2**31-1, 2**32-1 and 5; GET across 2**31 and 2**32, QUERY, and GET with a doubleword INCREMENT of 2**32: values kept exactly (hex)
